The controls cover all 960 policy runs, every policy budget and equal-cost
numerator, exact exclusive publication, issued-result/projection occurrence
binding, corrupted-stage denial, nested aggregate mutation, unknown primary
truth, empty secondary panels and undefined gate margins, early stops without
usefulness verdicts, usage/content identity separation, declared original versus
reproduction scientific identity, and complete/partial parsing whose stage
receipt could not be persisted. The legacy bridge's four binding failures and
the three pre-fix access-counter failures are retained with their passing
regressions. A separate peer fixed the corrupted-prefix BLOCKED-result issuance
problem; these controls require persistence verification before publication.

These are constructed-data controls. No actual archive, local scientific feature
table, performance targets, source-group allocation, or scientific allocation
entropy provider was used. Temporary directory naming is ordinary test harness
behavior, not a study allocation. The registered-mode control uses declared
fingerprint metadata only; it neither authenticates nor reads that source.
Passing the review does not establish exchangeability, endpoint semantics,
physical attainability, prediction advantage, or a scientific study outcome.

Only named direct files in `copyset-v1.json` form the review copyset. Do not copy
the interrupted synthetic `constructed-*` directories or `__pycache__`; they are
ignored test workspace, not public artifacts. No main-tree source was edited by
this review lane. Read `README.md` for the preserved preliminary-run provenance.
